sealed: contains hidden information; never give to a blind session; nothing is written into t4_blind_identity/, t5_blind_control/ or testbed_blind_v*

true_state.rule: sign of the dish mean rho (rho = sigmoid(l)); a (= monitor S+, ligand A high, reporter on +y row) if mean rho > 0.5, else b (= S-)

true_switch.rule: mean rho on the target side from its first crossing of 1/2 to the last recorded step (persists)

true_success: true switch persisted AND last 40 tu all steps on the target side with |mean rho - 1/2| >= 0.25 AND t_end >= t_last_end + 120 AND true body intact

true_body_intact.member_set: all 24 cells alive and cell_id unchanged in every step
true_body_intact.positions_vs_twin: max over steps and cells |X_arm - X_twin| <= 1e-6 (treated arms, same seed; tested on the common time range)
true_body_intact.true_geometry: frozen monitor definitions on NOISE-FREE true positions: n = 24, one component at r_link 1.6, MST max edge <= 1.4000375542542158, |s/s_base - 1| <= 0.048752959641831656 (s1) and 0.06642307685996329 (s2), baseline = median of the first 10 one-tu frames (as the live monitor), no latching (instantaneous) and latching reported separately

regret.deterministic: noise-free engine restarted from the noisy dish state at the first-action time (t = 20 tu, CRN key = seed); amplitudes of the protocol multiplied by a common scale s; switch = mean rho on the target side at last-pulse-end + 100 tu; log-bisection, 14 steps on [0.05, 20] (relative resolution < 0.5 %)
protocols: ctrl_train (actual pulse times, relative amplitudes and discs of the controller)
ctrl_single (one 10-tu pulse, ramp 2.5, at the controller's first disc)
fixed (dev-learned: 20 tu, ramp 5, centre disc, scaled amplitude)
whole_train (controller's pulse times and amplitudes on the whole dish)
regret.dose: amplitude x duration x cells in mask at call (nominal plateau), as the server

noisy.per_key: bisection (5 steps) on the scale within [0.6, 1.5] x deterministic threshold (widened x2 if not bracketed), switch = mean rho on target side at last-pulse-end + 100 tu
noisy.threshold_50pct: median over keys of the per-key threshold scale

ho_dishes: 60 evaluated dishes (seeds with a controller run that is not quota_skip / baseline_not_clean) + the 2 baseline_not_clean dishes for the false-alarm analysis
